description:
As a customer, I want to sort the products.

* Sorting should work properly.

cases.title: Products are sorted correctly for each available sorting option
cases.preconditions: Access to the product listing page with <a product category/search result containing several products with differing values for each sortable attribute>. The sorting options available in the application are known to the tester (the story does not specify them).
steps: Open the product listing page showing <a product category/search result containing several products>.
Note the products currently displayed and their relevant attribute values.
Select the first available sorting option.
Compare the resulting order of products against the expected order for that option.
Repeat steps 3-4 for every remaining sorting option offered by the application.
cases.expected: For each sorting option, the products are re-ordered according to that option and the resulting order is correct. The exact set of sorting options, their labels and the sort direction are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting applied to a list with no products or a single product
cases.preconditions: Access to the product listing page that can show <a category/search result returning zero products> and <a category/search result returning exactly one product>.
steps: Open the product listing page for <a category/search result returning zero products>.
Open the product listing page for <a category/search result returning exactly one product>.
cases.expected: Sorting is applied without error: the empty list stays empty and the single-product list still shows that one product. The exact behaviour and any message for an empty list are not specified in the story.
